entries.name: Overlord Individually Configured Client Sample
entries.classification: Remote administration tool observed in a maliciously configured deployment

sourceRepository.relationship: Static source comparison and build-system analysis linked the analysed sample to the Overlord codebase.
sourceRepository.projectDisclaimer: This entry concerns the analysed sample, its compiled configuration and associated deployment evidence. It is not an allegation against every contributor, fork, researcher or legitimate user of the public repository.

networkAttribution.limitation: Hosting allocation identifies infrastructure ownership, not the person who rented, controlled or used the server.

githubDisclosure.statement: Community Watch Network has prepared a disclosure package. At the time of this database snapshot, no GitHub report has been confirmed as submitted. Publishing this database entry does not automatically submit a report to GitHub.
githubDisclosure.disclaimer: GitHub determines whether repository content violates its policies. CWN is supplying technical evidence for review and does not claim that every repository contributor participated in malicious activity.

mitreAttack.basis: Registry and startup persistence capabilities were present.

evidence.title: Configuration loader reference
evidence.description: The endpoint is used when no server override exists.

evidence.title: Fallback server reference
evidence.description: The same endpoint is inserted when no server URLs are configured.

evidence.title: Embedded build token
evidence.description: The token contains a build UUID, internal account ID and issuance timestamp.

evidence.title: Public Telegram reference
evidence.description: The public project repository references the Telegram account @Onimai.
evidence.limitation: This evidence records a public association only and does not independently identify the sample operator.

limitations: Static analysis does not prove that every embedded command was executed.
The builder account ID does not identify a real-world person.
The endpoint allocation does not identify the subscriber or operator.
The token signature has not yet been verified.
The suspected endpoint was not contacted.
Publishing this entry does not itself submit a GitHub report.
The public Telegram reference does not independently establish the identity of the sample builder, distributor or operator.
Publishing this database entry does not automatically submit a report to GitHub.
GitHub must independently assess whether the repository or its content violates platform policy.
The findings concern the analysed sample and do not allege that every contributor or user of the repository acted maliciously.
